census.note: Recorded 2026-09-18 on the ratification candidate. The count is not a pinned contract fact: drift is caught by the declared-edge facts below, which the harness re-reads live; the census command is how the count is reproduced.

nativeProcessImport.definition: Runtime reachability of process spawning, filesystem, thread spawning or socket syscalls from the browser dependency closure.
nativeProcessImport.blocking: A native process import blocks that browser build (BWH0-AC1): the build must fail or the operation must be excluded before any browser artifact ships.
nativeProcessImport.recurringProofOwner: BWH1 (browser semantic-host feasibility and build proof)

inertOsMetadata.note: Declaration-only metadata pulled unconditionally by ts-rs's termcolor; it compiles on wasm32 and executes nothing. Misclassifying this chain as a process import, or citing it as proof the closure is native-free without the census, are both rejected.

seams.wasm: getrandom wasm_js backend (.cargo/config.toml getrandom_backend="wasm_js"; verter_wasm declares the wasm_js feature) plus uuid js feature (WebCrypto)

seams.native: scheduler driver thread, CPU/IO pools, blocking semaphore, rayon batch compile
seams.wasm: sync inline drive (wait_or_drive); native-only primitives compiled out

exports.semanticHostExports: none; semantic-rail TypeScript answers come only from the pinned typescript@6.0.3 worker (ExternalOwner)
exports.engineCapabilityModel: fail-closed: tsgo: false for every TypeScript major (capabilityForWasm); no WASM tsgo exists or is attempted

rules: Adding any forbidden crate (or any process/fs/thread/socket syscall route) to the wasm32-reachable declared edges is a failing fact, not a silent degradation (BWH0-AC1).
The inert windows-sys chain stays classified inert-metadata; reclassifying it as a blocking import without a runtime process route is rejected.
A new wasm32 seam is a PlatformHostServices row first (receiving-owner amendment), then code.
